title: ‘I do not know if the doctor survived’: young mothers recall ‘living hell’ of Nepal’s floods
image_alt: ‘I do not know if the doctor survived’: young mothers recall ‘living hell’ of Nepal’s floods
summary: Kalpana Nepali was seven months pregnant when the flash floods hit last month, while Pooja Pariyal spent three days on a hospital roof waiting to be rescued. Now, they are living precariously in temporary shelters.
